prompt: Environmental pollution has become one of the most serious issues in today's world. what are the causes of environmental pollution? What measures can be taken to tackle this problem?
essay:
One of the most serious problems nowadays is environmental degradation, which is mainly caused by the excessive use of fossil fuels and mass manufacturing. However, increasing the use of renewable energy and promoting recycling can help tackle this issue.

The widespread application of fossil fuels has caused significant damage to the planet. Many machines, vehicles and power plants rely on burning oil, gas or coal, which releases harmful emissions into the atmosphere and contributes to global warming. Moreover, mass manufacturing has made products cheaper and more widely available, encouraging people to consume and replace them frequently. Consequently, large amounts of waste are produced, which may be burned, buried or dumped into the sea. These practices pollute the air, soil and water. For instance, plastic rubbish that enters the ocean can be ingested by marine animals or cause them to become trapped, leading to injuries and deaths and disrupting marine ecosystems.

One way to tackle this problem is to reduce dependence on oil and increase the application of renewable energy. Sources such as solar and wind power produce little or no direct greenhouse-gas emissions during electricity generation, so replacing part of the energy produced from combustible materials with these alternatives could help slow global warming. Furthermore, encouraging people to recycle would reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills and limit the need for new raw materials. Manufacturers could also apply recycled materials in their products, reducing both rubbish and resource consumption. For example, recycling plastic bottles into new packaging can reduce the amount of plastic sent to landfills or the ocean while decreasing the need to produce new plastic.

In conclusion, the excessive use of petrol and mass production have contributed significantly to environmental pollution. However, reducing reliance on these fuels and expanding recycling practices can help limit the damage and protect the environment.
